org.copyFailed: Could not copy the organization ID
org.invite.title: Invite user
org.invite.description: Invite someone by email. They join with the role you choose.
org.invite.roleHint: Pick the role that fits the person; add more roles only when they need them.
org.invite.outsideBadge: They are marked as outside your organization wherever members are listed.
org.invite.stepUpNote: You will confirm your identity when you send: this role is above member.
org.invite.mfaNote: They must use two-factor authentication to open the organization.
org.invite.ssoExceptionNote: Your organization enforces single sign-on: an owner must add them as an SSO exception so they can sign in.
org.invite.accessEndsOptionalHint: Leave empty to keep access until you remove them.
org.invite.accessEndsRequiredHint: Your organization requires an end date for people outside it: {days} days if you leave it empty.
org.invite.createdBody: {email} joins after opening the invitation link. When email is configured they also receive it by email.
org.invite.lookalikeBody: {email} reaches the same mailbox as {others}. Check that this is not the same person with a second account.
org.invite.outsideJoined: {email} is outside your organization and is marked as such.
org.invite.shownOnceBody: Anyone with this link can join as {email}. It will not be shown again; cancel the invitation and invite again if it is lost.
org.invite.code.INVITEE_NOT_ON_VERIFIED_: Your organization invites only addresses on its verified domains.
org.invite.code.INVITEE_DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOW: Your organization invites only addresses on its verified or allowed domains.
org.invite.code.PERSONAL_ACCOUNTS_BLOCKE: Your organization does not accept personal email addresses.
org.invite.code.ABOVE_TRUST_CEILING: The trust with this person's organization does not allow this role.
org.invite.code.ALREADY_MEMBER: This person is already a member.
org.invite.code.ALREADY_INVITED: This person already has a pending invitation.
org.invite.code.ROLE_NOT_GRANTABLE: One of these roles cannot be given.
org.invite.code.ADMIN_NEEDS_OWNER: Only the owner can make someone an administrator.
org.invite.code.INVITATIONS_RATE_LIMITED: You sent many invitations in the last hour. Try again later.
org.invite.code.generic: The invitation could not be created. Try again.
org.invitations.mfaHint: The role is above member for someone outside the organization: they must use two-factor authentication.
org.invitations.resendTooSoon: This invitation was sent recently. Wait a few minutes before sending it again.
org.invitePolicy.title: Who can be invited
org.invitePolicy.description: Applies when an invitation is sent and when it is accepted. People outside your organization are always marked as such.
org.invitePolicy.anyHint: Any email address, including personal ones and other companies' domains.
org.invitePolicy.verified_domainsHint: Only addresses on the domains your organization has verified.
org.invitePolicy.allow_listHint: Verified domains plus the allowed email domains below. Add an allowed domain to use this.
org.invitePolicy.endRequired: Require an end of access for people outside
org.invitePolicy.endRequiredHint: For outside people no organization manages (for example personal addresses): 90 days by default, 365 at most.
org.roleTemplate.updateBody: The {template} template changed since this role was created from it (version {from} to {to}). Your role does not change until you apply the update.
org.roleTemplate.keepsEdits: Your own changes to the role are kept. Full data access is never changed by an update.
org.acceptInvite.acceptedBody: This invitation has already been accepted.
org.acceptInvite.acceptFailed: The invitation could not be accepted.
org.acceptInvite.declineBody: You will not join {org}. The person who invited you can send a new invitation later.
org.acceptInvite.declinedBody: You declined the invitation to {org}. Nothing was shared with the organization.
org.acceptInvite.declineFailed: The invitation could not be declined. Try again.
org.acceptInvite.expiredBody: This invitation has expired. Ask the person who invited you for a new one.
org.acceptInvite.incomplete: This invitation link is incomplete. Open the link from your invitation email again.
org.acceptInvite.loadFailed: The invitation could not be loaded. Try again.
org.acceptInvite.mfaOutside: You will set up two-factor authentication before you can open {org}: your roles are privileged and you are outside the organization.
org.acceptInvite.mfaPolicy: {org} requires two-factor authentication: you will set it up before you can open it.
org.acceptInvite.newHere: New here? Create an account for {email}, then accept the invitation.
org.acceptInvite.noAccessEnd: Your access has no end date.
org.acceptInvite.noTeams: No teams yet. You will see data once a team includes you.
org.acceptInvite.noTeamsFullData: No teams. Your role sees all of the organization's data.
org.acceptInvite.notFound: Invitation not found or has expired.
org.acceptInvite.otherAccount: Sign in with a different account
org.acceptInvite.outside: You join from outside {org}. Members see an External badge next to your name.
org.acceptInvite.subtitle: {name} invited you to join {org}.
org.acceptInvite.title: Invitation
org.invite.teams.hint: Optional. Teams give access to their assets and findings. Without a team, a member who does not see all data sees nothing.
org.invite.teams.label: Teams
org.invite.teams.none: This organization has no teams yet.
org.invite.code.TEAM_NOT_GRANTABLE: You cannot add people to one of these teams.
org.ownership.dialog.title: Transfer ownership
org.ownership.dialog.description: Ask {name} to become the owner of this organization. Nothing changes until they accept, within 72 hours, after signing in again.
org.ownership.check.title: The new owner must be
org.ownership.previousRole.label: After the transfer, you become
org.ownership.previousRole.hint: Your custom roles and teams stay. Only the owner can delete the organization, make administrators and change security settings.
org.ownership.outsider.notice: {name} is outside the organization and no organization manages their address. When they accept, they become an internal member and their end of access is removed.
org.ownership.outsider.confirm: I confirm that {name} becomes an internal member
org.ownership.banner.newOwnerTitle: {name} asked you to become the owner
org.ownership.banner.newOwnerBody: As the owner you can delete the organization, make administrators and change its security settings. {from} becomes {role}. You will sign in again to accept. The request expires on {date}.
org.ownership.banner.ownerBody: Nothing changes until they accept. When they do, you become {role}. The request expires on {date}.
org.ownership.banner.becomesInternal: You also become an internal member: your end of access is removed.
org.ownership.confirm.acceptDesc: You will be asked to sign in again. You become the owner and {from} becomes {role}.
org.ownership.confirm.declineDesc: {from} stays the owner and is told that you declined.
org.ownership.confirm.cancelDesc: You stay the owner. {name} is told that the request was canceled.
org.ownership.blocker.inactive: Only an active member can become the owner.
org.ownership.blocker.managed: Another organization manages this person, so they cannot become the owner.
org.ownership.blocker.mfa: They must turn on two-factor authentication first.
org.ownership.error.notOwner: Only the owner can transfer ownership.
org.ownership.error.pending: A transfer is already waiting for an answer. Cancel it first.
org.ownership.error.notFound: This transfer is no longer open.
org.ownership.error.expired: This transfer has expired. Ask the owner for a new one.
org.ownership.error.void: The person who asked is no longer the owner, so this transfer is void.
org.ownership.blocker.service: A service account cannot own an organization.
org.ownership.error.confirmInternal: Confirm that this person becomes an internal member.
org.ownership.error.previousRole: Choose administrator, member or viewer for yourself.
org.invite.code.LIMIT_REACHED: The organization's limit is reached (seats or invitations a day).
